title: Dokumentasi Teknis Aplikasi
summary: Comprehensive developer-facing technical documentation for the PLTU Tenayan Fuel Management System covering features, architecture, data models, API map, conventions, and roadmap.
notes: Document is prose-heavy developer onboarding/architecture guide covering many domains. Contains SPEC-like content (API endpoint listings in section 8, data models in section 7) but framed as descriptive 'peta endpoint' rather than authoritative contracts; dominant character is general technical documentation with conventions, roadmap, and tutorial structure. Classified DOC over SPEC because endpoint and model listings are illustrative summaries of existing system, not normative contracts. Synthesizer may wish to extract section 7 (data models) and section 8 (API map) as auxiliary SPEC-grade signals.
